summary.text: Grace Marrero is a retired Bronx native running for New York State Senate District 36 on the Conservative Party line. She was the Conservative Party candidate for State Assembly District 80 in 2024 and for Bronx Borough President in 2025. In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey she describes herself as a community leader and advocate for more than 20 years.

paragraphs.text: Born in the Bronx, New York.
Earned a high school diploma from Christopher Columbus High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Texas at Austin in 1980.

Her Ballotpedia profile lists her profession as retired. In her 2024 Candidate Connection survey she describes herself as a mother, grandmother and great-grandmother and a community leader and advocate for the past 20-plus years.
Ran for New York State Assembly District 80 in 2024 on the Conservative Party line, receiving 5.2% of the vote in the general election won by Democratic incumbent John Zaccaro Jr.
Ran for Bronx Borough President in 2025 on the Republican and Conservative Party lines, receiving 17.0% of the vote against incumbent Vanessa Gibson.
